source: docs/changelog.md, For Learners notes that match a page

items.title: Field Talkies
items.desc: Short films that explain the hard parts of development practice, starting with the logframe and how to present evidence to people who decide.

items.title: Who is still at work at five o'clock
items.desc: A data Deep Dive on how long Indians work, who works on Sunday, what an hour of that work produces, and the unpaid shift women do on top…

items.title: Survey Instrument Library
items.desc: 26 validated scales and modules for mental health, food security, nutrition, empowerment, disability, learning and social capital…

items.title: Decolonizing Methodologies
items.desc: Linda Tuhiwai Smith on research done to Indigenous peoples and how communities can set the terms…

items.title: Seeing Like a Feminist
items.desc: Nivedita Menon on family, body, desire, law and sexual violence in India, with an audit for gender programmes.

items.title: Black Feminist Thought
items.desc: Patricia Hill Collins on the matrix of domination and standpoint, read beside Dalit feminist work.

items.title: Making Sense of the University
items.desc: Debaditya Bhattacharya on what India's public university is for, with a publicness audit.

items.title: Palestine: A Primer
items.desc: Rashid Khalidi's account, attributed throughout, with notes for humanitarian and refugee work.

items.title: The Political Unconscious
items.desc: Fredric Jameson's method for reading texts, made readable, with a protocol for reading policy documents.

items.title: Algiers, Third World Capital
items.desc: Elaine Mokhtefi's memoir of Algeria after independence and Third World solidarity.

items.title: Social Protection and Welfare Delivery in India
items.desc: A new flagship course in 13 modules with a 50-term lexicon: the food law and the ration shop, who gets counted, how benefits are paid…

items.title: Agriculture and Food Systems 101
items.desc: Who farms and on how much land, MSP and procurement, the 2020 farm laws and their repeal, the PDS, subsidies, irrigation…

items.title: Urban Development and Municipal Governance 101
items.desc: Census towns and the 74th Amendment, how towns raise and spend money, the urban missions, street vendors, urban job guarantees, heat and floods.

items.title: Water, Sanitation and Hygiene 101
items.desc: Why India's sanitation and water numbers disagree, Swachh Bharat, Jal Jeevan Mission, groundwater, sanitation work and the law…

items.title: Disaster Risk and Heat Resilience 101
items.desc: The Sendai Framework, the Disaster Management Act and its 2025 amendment, the disaster funds, cyclones, floods, drought, heat and outdoor work…

items.title: Running an NGO in India
items.desc: A law guide on trusts, societies and Section 8 companies, approvals under the Income-tax Act, 2025, audits and returns, CSR-1…

items.title: Land, Forest and Resource Rights
items.desc: A law guide on land acquisition, Forest Rights Act claims, PESA and the Fifth Schedule, land records and the 2023 forest law amendment…

items.title: Analysing Indian Survey Data
items.desc: A Code School course on NFHS, PLFS and HCES unit-level files in R and Python: survey weights, strata and clusters…
